Refund Policy

Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase.

Refund requests must be submitted through the customer portal or by contacting support.

Refunds are processed within 5 business days after approval.

Digital products are refundable only if they have not been extensively used.

Refunds will be credited to the original payment method.

Cancellation Policy

Customers may cancel their subscriptions at any time through the account settings page.

Cancellation requests take effect at the end of the current billing cycle.

No additional charges will be applied after cancellation.

Refund eligibility depends on the refund policy.

Users retain access to subscribed services until the billing period ends.

Warranty Policy

All physical products include a one-year limited warranty.

The warranty covers manufacturing defects and hardware failures under normal usage conditions.

The warranty does not cover accidental damage, misuse, or unauthorized modifications.

Customers must provide proof of purchase when requesting warranty service.

Warranty claims are reviewed within 7 business days.
